description: right salpingo-oophorectomy, fimbria entirely submitted, p53 signature with overexpression and low Ki-67
report:
Right fallopian tube and ovary, salpingo-oophorectomy

Received in formalin is a right salpingo-oophorectomy specimen. The fallopian tube measures 5.5 cm in length and 0.6 cm in diameter, with a fimbriated end. The ovary measures 3 x 2 x 1.2 cm, with an unremarkable cut surface. The fimbriated end is entirely submitted, with representative sections of the remainder, in 4 blocks.

(1) Fimbria, entirely submitted. (2) Fallopian tube, cross sections. (3-4) Ovary.

Sections show fimbrial tissue and cross sections of the right fallopian tube with unremarkable plicae. The fallopian tube epithelium shows no cytological abnormality. Immunohistochemistry shows strong nuclear p53 expression in a short stretch of tubal epithelial cells. Only scattered cells are positive for Ki-67. The features are those of a p53 signature. The ovary shows corpora albicantia. There is no evidence of STIC or invasive malignancy.

RIGHT FALLOPIAN TUBE AND OVARY, salpingo-oophorectomy - p53 SIGNATURE; corpora albicantia, ovary; NO EVIDENCE OF MALIGNANCY
